result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with commercial land use and significant vehicle traffic. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the pedestrian environment is degraded by faded crosswalk markings, long crossing distances, and debris obstructing the walkway.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn and faded, reducing visibility of the pedestrian zone to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large piles of trash bags are blocking a significant portion of the sidewalk near the corner, forcing pedestrians into a narrower path or potentially the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, along the sidewalk in front of the commercial buildings

hazards.name: Wide Intersection Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears wide, which can encourage higher vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulbout)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Given the width of the roadway, a median refuge island would allow pedestrians to cross in stages.
